newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt widens poll lead over opp'n.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt widens poll lead over opp'n.

text.p: Australia's Liberal-National government widened its already commanding opinion poll lead over the Labor opposition in the latest poll published in Tuesday's The Australian newspaper.

The government's support increased one point from the last poll two weeks ago to 51 percent, while Labor's fell three points to 34 percent -- its lowest level in seven months, The Australian's Newspoll found.
Prime Minister John Howard also increased his lead over opposition leader Kim Beazley as preferred prime minister to 34 points from 31 points in the last poll.
Howard's rating as preferred prime minister increased one point to 55 percent, while Beazley's rating fell two points to 21 percent.
The latest result compares with the government's primary vote of 47.3 percent and Labor's 38.8 percent in the March 2 national election that ended 13 years of Labor rule.
The Newspoll surveyed 1,151 voters around the country by telephone over the last weekend.
